source.title: Our Milky Way Gets a Makeover  Artist Concept

note: An artist's concept: nobody has photographed our galaxy from outside. The grid numbers are read by scripts/galaxy/measure.py from the annotated version of the same picture (1600 px): the Sun's place, the step of the circles round it — one circle every 5,000 light-years by the picture's own labels — and how far above the Sun the bright middle is. They only lay the picture in its place; what the texts say is NASA's words (docs/GALAXY.md).
